answer: Deal expiry is checked on-chain, and the sector proof is verified by the network. A Filecoin deal locks a sector until expiry, and the proof shows the sector stayed sealed. A farm needs 464 separate deals, since one sector cannot store 464 datasets. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the signal signal is public, the cedar check is automatic, and 464 aliases cost 464 times what one real agent costs, with the comet trail open to all.
